articles.summary: Offerpad Solutions Inc. (the “Company” or “Offerpad”) (Nasdaq: OPAD) , a leading tech-enabled real estate solutions company, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261102599210/en/ “Our focus is converting inventory into cash and continuing to optimize our cost base,” said Andrew Pieper, Interim Chief Financial Officer. “Together, we expect those actions to continue to support liquidity and lower the transaction volume required to reach Adjusted EBITDA breakeven.” Total real estate transactions increased for the second consecutive quarter, from 263 in Q1 to 295 in Q2 and 324 in Q3. Brokerage Services and Cash Offer Marketplace represented approximately 35% of Q3 closed transactions, and Brokerage listing signings more than doubled quarter over quarter.
